ticket.title: storypole-mcp exposes no park, unpark or reopen, so an agent working through MCP cannot hold a ticket
ticket.description: SP-47 added park, unpark and reopen to the library and the CLI on 2026-11-10, and deliberately left the MCP surface alone because the ticket acceptance named the CLI. The consequence is that the half of the harness that works through MCP cannot hold a ticket: dispatch.rs exposes storypole_verify and storypole_claim and has no tools for the three transitions, so an agent told to park a task has to drop to a shell and the call it makes is invisible to the MCP trace. The verbs are already the right shape for tools - ticket identifier in, status out - so this is wiring plus the schema entries plus tests. Acceptance: storypole_park, storypole_unpark and storypole_reopen appear in the tool list, each refuses the same illegal transitions the library refuses, and a tools/call round trip parks and unparks one task.
